items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: You had Frank Foster here. These are all dear friends of mine.

ctx.x: Yeah. So it’s still happening but it’s an awful small—
You’ve got Joe Wilder here. You had Clark Terry here, which is what brought me here, you had Milt Hinton, which is what brought me here.
